name: Form breaks on cached pages
query: Our frontend review form works for us but visitors report 'Security check failed' after a few hours. The site uses LiteSpeed Cache.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Identify the nonce printed into cached HTML for logged-out visitors as the cause
Step 3: Fetch the nonce (or the whole form state) via an uncached REST/AJAX request after load, or rely on validation + rate limiting for anonymous submissions
Step 4: Do not disable caching site-wide
Step 5: Test logged out with the cache enabled and a short nonce_life
success_criteria: Anonymous submissions still validated and rate-limited
